entries.name: Lucretia Collins

expected.charges: Freedom Ride participation — attempting to desegregate interstate-terminal facilities, Jackson, May 24, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-05-24. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Jailed in Jackson on May 24, 1961 and released from Hinds County jail on $500 bond on May 27, 1961 to return to Nashville for graduation. The release is documented by contemporary Associated Press reporting and a photograph caption; no Parchman transfer is established.

entries.rationale: May 28, 1961 Sunday newspaper AP photo identifies Collins leaving Hinds County jail Saturday after Wednesday arrest. Report says she posted $500 cash bond Saturday to graduate Sunday night. Thus May 24 to May 27, 1961; release is explicit, not sentence arithmetic.

entries.name: Ronald Lockman

expected.charges: Refusal of military orders to deploy to Vietnam
expected.sentence: Sentenced to two and a half years of hard labor at a general court-martial in November 1967; the sentence was reduced by six months in July 1968. CCCO lists him actually imprisoned at Fort Leavenworth in May–June and July–August 1968. Imposed sentence is not treated as actual time served.

entries.rationale: Contemporary TIME November 24, 1967 reports stockade confinement immediately after September refusal. Contemporary reports differ on exact September day, so only September month precision is stored. Existing sentence and unknown release preserved.
